## Overview

This directory contains Root Cause Analyses related to data corruption, quality issues, ETL failures, and information management problems that affect business operations.
page_texts.3:
[rcas/information/README.md#examples-of-information-rcas]

## Examples of Information RCAs

- Data corruption or loss incidents
- ETL/data pipeline failures
- Data quality issues affecting business decisions
- Master data management failures
- Data synchronization problems between systems
- Reporting/analytics inaccuracies
- Database performance degradation
- Data warehouse loading failures
- Backup and recovery failures
- Data privacy and retention policy violations
